#2026世界市长对话宁波#
【“2026世界市长对话·宁波”活动宣传片发布】11月2日至5日，“2026世界市长对话·宁波”活动举行。“2026世界市长对话·宁波”宣传片《海纳百川》破浪而来。从开启中华海洋文明的一道道桨痕，到世界第一大港，在宁波，以“开放融通·共生机遇”为主题，与世界城市对话。
The 2026 Global Mayors Dialogue · Ningbo will be held from November 2 to 5. The official promotional video for the event, "Where All Rivers Merge into the Sea," has been released. From the first wooden paddle that heralded the beginning of China's maritime civilization to the world's largest port, Ningbo, under the theme of "Openness and Connectivity for Shared Opportunities," engages in dialogue with the world.
